description: Pope Leo XIV's visit to France, from September 25 to 28, marks the first official state visit by a pope in 18 years. headline: Ancient wall discovered in Paris, possibly confirming site of city's original settlement
description: The stone-and-wood wall, about 20 meters long, was unearthed in the heart of Paris, the Ministry of Culture said. It may be a fragment of the rampart of Lutetia, built by the Gallic Parisii tribe.
